name: E8ight
summary: E8 Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of simulation-based digital twin solutions for predicting and resolving problems that may occur through simulations. Its products include NAX Ops, NAXIS, NDX Pro, NFLOW AI, and NDX Cloud. The company was founded by Jin-Hyun Kim on May 7, 2012 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
